pages.text: Tools are also needed in this world. Getting the resources I needed for tools in the usual way turned out to be impossible—the floor was incredibly hard, and I didn't find any trees in this world. But the solution was always at hand: ready-made planks already exist in this world—in furniture. The same goes for other resources.
But even so, I had to replace many materials with local alternatives. Furthermore, I created armor prototypes from local materials. The protective qualities are mediocre, but there isn't much choice.
